_doc: F6: a SIGSTOP'd direct subscriber + flood publisher trips the per-client slowSubscriber flag. Exercises list-slow-subscribers — the only MCP tool dedicated to this state. Distinct from F5 (a slow-ACK guaranteed consumer never trips this flag — see SOL-150328), so this scenario is the suite's only direct test of the tool. Runs on both brokers because $F6_SUB_CLIENT_NAME differs per broker.
prompt: Which clients on $BROKER are flagged as slow subscribers right now?
